entities.name: Ribosome-binding factor A
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (135 aa) to reviewed Vibrio campbellii UniProt A7MZI4; RBFA domain PF02033 spans residues 7–110.
Annotated role: assists late maturation of the 30S ribosomal subunit, associates with free 30S subunits, and supports efficient 16S rRNA processing; cytoplasmic.

entities.name: SSU-rRNA maturation
observations: Reviewed homolog annotation assigns this protein a role in maturation of the small-subunit rRNA (GO:0030490).
